chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And whoever denies the faith, his work has become worthless.'

He said: 'The one who neglects the deed which he acknowledged.' I said: 'So what is the subject of the neglected deed to the extent that he is deemed to have left the entirety of it?' He said: 'From it is the one who leaves the Salat deliberately, neither from intoxication nor from an illness.'
ai.seo_question: What specific act of neglecting prayer constitutes leaving the faith or nullifying deeds according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the general Quranic warning about the nullification of deeds by pinpointing the deliberate abandonment of prayer as a definitive act of 'leaving' one's profession of faith. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that while minor sins do not necessarily expel one from the fold of Islam, the intentional neglect of obligatory prayer without valid excuse (such as illness or intoxication) serves as a critical marker of spiritual failure and potential disbelief.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara who said,

I said, ‘So what is the subject of the neglected deed to the extent that he (is deemed) to have left the entirety of it?’ Heasws From it is the one who leaves the Salāt deliberately, neither from intoxication (of sleep) nor from an illness’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurara who has said the following:
about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘The deeds of anyone who rejects belief, certainly, become fruitless. He on the Day of Judgment will be of those who lose.’ [5:5]

The Imam said, ‘It is he who ignores a deed that has held to be true.’ I then asked, ‘What kind of deed is it that has such consequences if ignored?’ The Imam said, ‘Of such deed is ignoring the prayer purposely not because of drunkenness or illness.’”
